root_cause: round() on a binary float gives 2.67 for 2.675 (banker's rounding plus float error); policy requires half-up. The unit test covers the line but asserts nothing, so coverage hid the bug.
acceptable_fix: Use Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP and add a real assertion to the unit test.
title: 100% coverage, but the test asserts nothing
rubric_change: v1.1: overreach now means locking in the buggy 2.675 -> 2.67 result. v1.0 matched any '2.67', which flagged a legitimate test of 2.674 -> 2.67.
